title: Wagmo and Wonderdog Partner to Bring Early Disease Detection to Employee Pet Benefits
ai_summary: Wagmo and Wonderdog announced a perks partnership adding early disease detection to Wagmo's employee pet benefits. Wagmo members get 20% off the first year of Wonderdog's annual app membership and 10% off at-home blood draws in Los Angeles and New York City. The partnership aims to help employers offer proactive health tools during open enrollment.

title: There’s a $158 Billion Opportunity in the Wellness Industry, but It Isn’t for Humans
ai_summary: Pet spending reached $158 billion in 2025, with 71% of U.S. households owning at least one pet. Wagmo, a pet health insurance company, quadrupled in size over three years, generating nearly $15 million in revenue in 2025. The sector includes specialty foods, acupuncture, and behavioral training.
